title: fix: register Ask Jev in the hosted MCP catalog
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Ask Jev to the shared MCP catalog at `/mcp/ask-jev`, completing the discovery wiring missing from #15111.
- Reuses the existing MCP proxy and downstream billing, preserving caller credentials without adding a second charge.
- Adds service bindings for local, test, staging, and production, plus source documentation.
- Validated with 18 gateway/docs tests, 9 Ask Jev tests, Gen typecheck, Biome, and environment binding checks.

gist.headline: Ask Jev joins the hive
gist.blurb: Ask Jev is now properly listed in the hosted MCP garden at `/mcp/ask-jev`. Same proxy, same caller credentials, no mysterious second pollen tollbooth.
gist.summary: Registered Ask Jev in the shared hosted MCP catalog at `/mcp/ask-jev`, with environment service bindings and documentation while reusing the existing MCP proxy and downstream billing path.
gist.impact: MCP clients can now discover and use Ask Jev through the hosted catalog, with caller credentials preserved and no additional charge layer.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy MCP discovery garden: Polli helps a friendly Ask Jev terminal sign find its place among labeled tool-path flowers, while a CRT robot happily points to the newly visible `/mcp/ask-jev` route. A single glowing pollen path runs through the proxy garden to show credentials and billing continuing cleanly through one route.
